{
  "jobspec": "#!/bin/bash

# Flux batch script
#
# NOTE: The PBS script contains placeholders (e.g., <Processing Folder>, <subject_name>, <scan_name>, etc.).
# These cannot be concretely translated without values. This Flux version keeps them as environment variables.

# Required inputs (set before running):
#   PROCESSING_FOLDER
#   RUN_QUNEX_DIR
#   PARAMETER_DIR
#   GRAD_COEFF_DIR
#   QUNEX_SIF
#   SUBJECT_NAME
#   SCAN_NAME

PROCESSING_FOLDER=${PROCESSING_FOLDER:-"<Processing Folder>"}
RUN_QUNEX_DIR=${RUN_QUNEX_DIR:-"<directory of run_qunex.sh>"}
PARAMETER_DIR=${PARAMETER_DIR:-"<directory of parameter file>"}
GRAD_COEFF_DIR=${GRAD_COEFF_DIR:-"<directory of gradient_coefficient_files>"}
QUNEX_SIF=${QUNEX_SIF:-"<path to qunex oontainer/qunex.sif>"}
SUBJECT_NAME=${SUBJECT_NAME:-"<subject_name>"}
SCAN_NAME=${SCAN_NAME:-"<scan_name>"}

# Translated resources from PBS:
#   nodes=1:ppn=1 -> -N 1 -n 1
#   walltime=24:00:00 -> -t 24h
JOBID=$(flux batch -N 1 -n 1 -t 24h --wrap "bash $0 __flux_inner")

echo "Submitted Flux job: $JOBID"

if [ "${1:-}" = "__flux_inner" ]; then
  # NOTE: PBS mem=8gb not translated.
  # Performance implication: without a memory reservation/limit, the job may contend for memory or be OOM-killed, affecting reliability/performance.

  # NOTE: PBS node property ':haswell' not translated.
  # Performance implication: without a CPU-architecture constraint, the job may run on different hardware, changing performance.

  # NOTE: PBS -o/-e to <Processing Folder> not translated.
  # Performance implication: none; operational implication: stdout/stderr handling follows Flux defaults unless configured at submission.

  module load singularity-3.2.1

  flux run -n 1 singularity exec \
    -B "${RUN_QUNEX_DIR},${PARAMETER_DIR},${GRAD_COEFF_DIR}:/export/HCP/gradient_coefficient_files" \
    "${QUNEX_SIF}" \
    "${RUN_QUNEX_DIR}/run_qunex.sh" \
      --parameterfolder="${PARAMETER_DIR}" \
      --studyfolder="${PROCESSING_FOLDER}/${SUBJECT_NAME}" \
      --subjects="${SUBJECT_NAME}" \
      --scan="${SCAN_NAME}" \
      --overwrite=yes \
      --hcppipelineprocess=FunctionalPreprocessing
fi
"
}
